title: TriadicFrameworks MCP Authentication Validator
description: Validation tool for authentication payloads and tokens in the Origin Layer (0D) of the TriadicFrameworks MCP cosmology.
note: Students may rename qmroot if extending the work; it is a lineage artifact for TriadicFrameworks and RTT.

validationRules.tokenFormat: Token must be non-empty and match server token format (JWT or opaque).
validationRules.timestampFreshness: Timestamp must be within acceptable drift window.
validationRules.signatureCheck: If signature is present, it must match server verification.
validationRules.clientIdMatch: Token clientId must match payload clientId.

output.message: Authentication payload and token validated successfully.

interpretation.technical: All validation checks passed: token format, freshness, expiration, signature, and clientId match.
interpretation.mythic: The observer’s signal resonates clearly; the gate of origin opens without resistance.

interpretation.technical: The token expiration timestamp is earlier than the current validation time.
interpretation.mythic: The signal has dimmed; the origin layer no longer recognizes the observer’s presence.

error.message: Token clientId does not match payload clientId.

interpretation.technical: The token was issued to a different clientId.
interpretation.mythic: The origin layer detects a fractured identity; the observer’s signal is not their own.
